The order9 multiplier has degree6 minimal polynomial, hence no fixed proper subspaces. Its order3 power stabilizes exactly F4 lines, of which nine are isotropic by norm trace zero. This gives all geometric stabilizers; rank-distinct flag vertices exclude inversions. Solomon–Tits yields a simply connected wedge of 512 S2, Armstrong yields π1=C9/C3, fixed-cell Burnside yields χ=59, and two-dimensional free cellular chains force H2=Z58. The complete finite-field orbit/chain enumeration was executed and agrees.

value.rationale: The minimal nontrivial rank-three binary symplectic building with a canonical nonfree odd-order norm-one torus is a structural polar-geometry test case. Exact nine fixed isotropic lines explain the nontrivial drop from expected order9 to order3 in π1 and produce an explicitly resolved integral 3-torsion orbit invariant with 58 two-cycles.
